expressions.name: Setpoints
expressions.expression:
// MVR setpoints + tuning. Temps degC, press psia. Heater outputs are PWM duty 0..1.
static.runSystem    = 0
static.timeIncSec   = 0.00625
static.evapPressSet = 14.7
static.evapTempSet  = 100.0
static.superheatSet = 3.0
static.blowerRpmSet = 1500
static.feedRpmSet   = 60
static.kpSuper  = 0.05
static.kiSuper  = 0.01
static.kpMakeup = 0.05
static.kiMakeup = 0.01
static.surgeThresh = 1.0      // degC dT below which the bypass starts opening
static.surgeGain   = 5.0      // V per degC of surge
static.condLevelThresh = 2.5
static.demisterThresh  = 2.5
static.maxEvapPress    = 25.0
static.maxSteamPress   = 35.0
static.minSuperheat    = 0.5
static.superheatGraceTemp = 90   // superheat interlock only arms once evap > this (no cold-start trip)
static.maxVaporOut     = 140.0
static.productionSet = 0.3
static.feedPerLpm    = 100
static.autoBlow      = 0
static.autoFeed      = 0


// ===== MVR SIMULATOR params + one-time state init (top-level consts = init once) =====
static.simEnable     = 0        // 0 = real AI/TC, 1 = run the MVR simulator
static.simDriveHW    = 0        // in sim: 0 = dry (no real outputs), 1 = drive hardware (HIL)
static.simSpeed      = 120      // sim time accel (x real). Higher = faster dynamics
static.simAmbient    = 25       // degC ambient
static.simFeedSupply = 18       // degC cold feed water
static.simCevap      = 120000   // evaporator thermal mass (sets warm-up LAG)
static.simMakeupPow  = 8000     // makeup heater W at duty 1
static.simSuperPow   = 2000     // superheat heater W at duty 1
static.simSHgain     = 5        // degC superheat at full SH-heater duty (lower = heater works harder)
static.simUAsteam    = 1500     // HX -> evaporator heat recovery (W/degC)
static.simUAcond     = 1800     // condensing steam -> HX (W/degC)
static.simChx        = 14000    // HX thermal mass: 24 lb steel + ~2L water (J/degC)
static.simHX         = 25       // HX (steam-chest) metal+water temp state
static.simUAloss     = 30       // ambient/standby heat loss (W/degC)
static.simPRmax      = 1.25     // blower full-speed pressure ratio (PR)
static.simCompGain   = 60       // compression superheat on VaporOut (degC per PR-1)
static.simBlowerRated = 3450    // blower rated rpm
static.simTauBlower  = 2.0      // blower spin-up / vapor-out time const (s)
static.simTauP       = 3.0      // evaporator pressure response (s)
static.simTauSH      = 5.0      // superheat response (s)
static.simPumpRate   = 0.6      // condensate pump removal (level/min)
// sim state (updated every tick by MVRSim; init once here so SensorMux has
// valid values from tick 1)
static.simEvapTemp   = 25
static.simEvapPress  = 0.5   // ~Psat(ambient); rises with temp
static.simSteamPress = 0.5
static.simVaporIn    = 25
static.simVaporOut   = 25
static.simSteamChest = 25
static.simCondTemp   = 25
static.simFeedTemp   = 18
static.simSuperheat  = 0
static.simBlowerRpm  = 0
static.simCondLevel  = 1.0
static.simCondFlow   = 0
static.simDemisterWater = 0
static.simDemisterFlood = 0
static.simProd       = 0
// --- realism: surge / noise / condensate tank + self-calibrating flow meter ---
static.simClock       = 0      // accumulating sim-seconds (surge/noise phase)
static.simSurgeAmp    = 0.06   // production surge amplitude (fraction)
static.simFeedNoise   = 2.0    // feed-temp fluctuation (degC RMS)
static.simCondSubcool = 35     // condensate subcool below HX at steady state (degC)
static.simCondVol     = 0      // ACTUAL condensate tank volume (ml) -- sim state
static.simCondHold    = 0      // HX condensate holdup (ml) -- the formation delay
static.simCondHoldMax = 45     // condensate must build this in the HX before it flows (ml)
static.condHighML     = 170    // tank HIGH level sensor (ml)
static.condLowML      = 50     // tank LOW level sensor (ml)
static.simPumpMlMin   = 1100   // condensate pump removal rate (ml/min) when on
static.simFlowCalErr  = 1.12   // flow-meter mis-cal (reads ~12%% high) -- control corrects it
static.simFlowNoise   = 0.05   // flow-meter rate noise (fraction RMS)
static.simEvapInv     = 4000   // evaporator water inventory (ml) -- feed mass balance
static.simCondHigh    = 0
static.simCondLow      = 0
// condensate-meter CONTROL state
static.condCalFactor  = 1.0    // running flow-meter calibration (x on the raw reading)
static.condFillRaw    = 0      // RAW meter volume integrated over the current fill (ml)
static.condProduct    = 0      // calibrated lifetime product total (ml)
static.condVolEst     = 0      // control's level estimate (ml), snaps at the sensors
static.prevCondHigh   = 0
static.prevCondLow    = 0
// read-before-write state (init once; C++ statics start NaN otherwise)
static.makeupI       = 0
static.superI        = 0
static.condPumpOn    = 0
static.shArmed       = 0
static.mvrState      = 0

expressions.name: SensorMux
expressions.expression:
// ===== SENSOR MUX =====
// Every sensor is abstracted as static.yXxx. simEnable=1 -> controllers read the
// MVR simulator (sim* from MVRSim); simEnable=0 -> real AI/TC (identical to the
// original rig behavior). Block IF (not inline) for transpiler safety.
sim = static.simEnable
if ( sim ) then
    static.yEvapPress     = static.simEvapPress
    static.ySteamPress    = static.simSteamPress
    static.yVaporIn       = static.simVaporIn
    static.yVaporOut      = static.simVaporOut
    static.yEvapTemp      = static.simEvapTemp
    static.yDemisterFlood = static.simDemisterFlood
    static.yDemisterWater = static.simDemisterWater
    static.yCondLevel     = static.simCondLevel
    static.yCondFlow      = static.simCondFlow
    static.yCondHigh      = static.simCondHigh
    static.yCondLow       = static.simCondLow
else
    static.yEvapPress     = "AI:EvapPress"
    static.ySteamPress    = "AI:SteamPress"
    static.yVaporIn       = "TC:VaporIn"
    static.yVaporOut      = "TC:VaporOut"
    static.yEvapTemp      = "TC:EvapTemp"
    static.yDemisterFlood = "AI:DemisterFlood"
    static.yDemisterWater = "AI:DemisterWater"
    static.yCondLevel     = "AI:CondLevel"
    static.yCondFlow      = "AI:CondFlow"
    // real: derive HIGH/LOW from the single analog level (hysteresis band)
    // until two physical level switches are wired.
    static.yCondHigh      = "AI:CondLevel" > static.condLevelThresh
    static.yCondLow       = "AI:CondLevel" > (static.condLevelThresh - 0.5)
endif

expressions.name: SteamTables
expressions.expression:
// Saturation temps (Antoine, high range) + superheat. Tsat(P_psia) -> degC.
ep = static.yEvapPress
sp = static.ySteamPress
VaporIn = static.yVaporIn
VaporOut = static.yVaporOut
static.PressRatio = sp/ep
pressRatio = static.PressRatio

epmm = ep * 51.7149
if (epmm < 0) then
    epmm = 0
endif

spmm = sp * 51.7149
if (spmm < 0) then
    spmm = 0
endif

evapTsat  = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(epmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
steamTsat = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(spmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
static.evapTsat     = evapTsat
static.steamTsat    = steamTsat
static.superheatIn  = VaporIn  - evapTsat
static.superheatOut = VaporOut - steamTsat
static.deltaT       = steamTsat - evapTsat

expressions.name: Interlocks
expressions.expression:
// Safety interlocks -> heatOK / trip / alarm / HeaterEnable.
evapPress    = static.yEvapPress
steamPress   = static.ySteamPress
superHIn     = static.superheatIn
vaporOutTemp = static.yVaporOut
flood = static.yDemisterFlood > static.demisterThresh

// static errors are used for indicators
static.evapPErr     = (evapPress    > static.maxEvapPress)
static.steamPErr    = (steamPress   > static.maxSteamPress)
static.vaporOutTErr = (vaporOutTemp > static.maxVaporOut)
// Superheat (wet-compression) protection ARMS only after superheat is first
// established, and stays armed (latched) until the system stops -- this avoids
// the cold-start deadlock AND the trip/un-trip oscillation at a fixed temp.
shArmed = static.shArmed
if ( superHIn > (static.minSuperheat + 1.0) ) then
    shArmed = 1
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    shArmed = 0
endif
static.shArmed = shArmed
static.superHErr = (static.runSystem and shArmed and (superHIn < static.minSuperheat))
trip = 0
trip = trip or static.evapPErr
trip = trip or static.steamPErr
trip = trip or static.vaporOutTErr
trip = trip or flood
trip = trip or static.superHErr 
static.trip = trip

heatOK = static.runSystem and (trip == 0)
static.heatOK = heatOK
"DO:HeaterEnable" = heatOK
"DO:Alarm" = trip

expressions.name: SuperheatControl
expressions.expression:
// Superheat heater PI -> DO:SuperHtr PWM duty 0..1 (gated by heatOK).
superheatSet = static.superheatSet
superheatIn  = static.superheatIn
heatOK       = static.heatOK
ki           = static.kiSuper

err = static.superheatSet - static.superheatIn
iPrev = static.superI
i = iPrev
duty = 0
if ( static.heatOK ) then
    i = iPrev + static.kiSuper * err * static.timeIncSec
    i = clamp(i, 0, 1)
    duty = static.kpSuper * err + i
    if ( duty > 1 ) then
        duty = 1
        i = iPrev
    endif
    if ( duty < 0 ) then
        duty = 0
        i = iPrev
    endif
endif
static.superI = i
static.superDuty = duty
"DO:SuperHtr" = duty

expressions.name: MakeupControl
expressions.expression:
// Makeup/boiling heater PI -> DO:MakeupHtr PWM duty 0..1 (gated by heatOK).
err = static.evapTempSet - static.yEvapTemp
iPrev = static.makeupI
i = iPrev
duty = 0
if ( static.heatOK ) then
    i = iPrev + static.kiMakeup * err * static.timeIncSec
    i = clamp(i, 0, 1)
    duty = static.kpMakeup * err + i
    if ( duty > 1 ) then
        duty = 1
        i = iPrev
    endif
    if ( duty < 0 ) then
        duty = 0
        i = iPrev
    endif
endif
static.makeupI = i
static.makeupDuty = duty
"DO:MakeupHtr" = duty

expressions.name: BlowerControl
expressions.expression:
// Blower (VFD) production knob + proportional anti-surge bypass on AO (0-10V).
run = static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0)
static.vfdRpmRead = "VFD:VFD 1".RPM
"VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = run
if ( run ) then
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM" = static.blowerRpmSet
    "VFD:VFD 1.DIR" = 0
else
    "VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = 0
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM" = 0
endif
bypassV = (static.surgeThresh - static.deltaT) * static.surgeGain
bypassV = clamp(bypassV, 0, 10)
if ( run == 0 ) then
    bypassV = 0
endif
static.bypassV = bypassV
"AO:BypassValve" = bypassV

expressions.name: FeedwaterControl
CondensatePump
expressions.expression:
// Condensate: 2-level pump (HIGH 170 -> LOW 50) + flow-meter integration with
// per-fill SELF-CALIBRATION against the known 120 ml. The meter is noisy/off,
// but each pump cycle re-corrects condCalFactor so the accumulated product and
// level estimate stay accurate. Runs in real + sim (reads y* sensors).
dt = static.timeIncSec
// flow-meter integration must use the SAME elapsed-time base as the plant:
// real timeIncSec on hardware, but the sim-accelerated dt when simulating, so
// the calibration converges to the true meter error (not the simSpeed factor).
cdt = dt
if ( static.simEnable ) then
    cdt = dt * static.simSpeed
endif

// --- two-level pump hysteresis ---
pump = static.condPumpOn
if ( static.yCondHigh ) then
    pump = 1
endif
if ( static.yCondLow == 0 ) then
    pump = 0
endif
static.condPumpOn = pump
"DO:CondPump" = pump

// --- integrate the (mis-cal/noisy) flow meter ---
rawMl = static.yCondFlow * 1000 * cdt / 60        // RAW ml this tick (meter L/min -> ml)
static.condFillRaw = static.condFillRaw + rawMl  // RAW accumulated over current fill
calMl = rawMl * static.condCalFactor             // calibrated ml this tick
static.condProduct = static.condProduct + calMl  // lifetime calibrated product
static.condVolEst  = static.condVolEst + calMl   // level estimate (corrected at sensors)

// --- LOW reached (pump just emptied below low): start a fresh fill, snap level ---
if ( static.yCondLow == 0 and static.prevCondLow == 1 ) then
    static.condFillRaw = 0
    static.condVolEst  = static.condLowML
endif
// --- HIGH reached (fill complete): the RAW fill should equal 120 ml -> recal ---
if ( static.yCondHigh == 1 and static.prevCondHigh == 0 ) then
    known = static.condHighML - static.condLowML
    if ( static.condFillRaw > 1 ) then
        newCal = known / static.condFillRaw
        static.condCalFactor = static.condCalFactor * 0.4 + newCal * 0.6
    endif
    static.condVolEst = static.condHighML
endif
static.prevCondHigh = static.yCondHigh
static.prevCondLow  = static.yCondLow

expressions.name: DemisterDrain
expressions.expression:
// Demister: drain whenever liquid water is present.
"DO:DemisterDrain" = static.yDemisterWater > static.demisterThresh

expressions.name: monitorMotor
expressions.expression:
// Read the VFD for motor performance values

rpm = "VFD:VFD 1".RPM
voltage = "VFD:VFD 1".VOLTAGE
current = "VFD:VFD 1".CURRENT
powerkw = "VFD:VFD 1".POWER
torque  = "VFD:VFD 1".TORQUE
accel   = "VFD:VFD 1.P0.12"
accelRaw = "VFD:VFD 1#0xF012"
sink    = "VFD:VFD 1.P07.06"
enable  = "VFD:VFD 1".ENABLE

static.vfdEnable  = enable
static.vfdOutVolt = voltage
static.vfdOutAmps = current
static.vfdOutPwr  = powerkw
static.vfdTorque  = torque
static.accel      = accel
static.accelraw   = accelRaw
static.sink       = sink

expressions.name: ProductionControl
expressions.expression:
// PLACEHOLDER (disabled): blower follows distillate production.
err = static.productionSet - static.yCondFlow
adj = static.blowerRpmSet
if ( static.autoBlow ) then
    adj = static.blowerRpmSet + 50 * err * static.timeIncSec
    adj = clamp(adj, 0, 4025)
    static.blowerRpmSet = adj
endif

expressions.name: FeedFollow
expressions.expression:
// PLACEHOLDER (disabled): feed follows production (mass balance).
if ( static.autoFeed ) then
    static.feedRpmSet = static.productionSet * static.feedPerLpm
endif

expressions.name: MVR System
expressions.expression:
// MVR System

state = static.mvrState


//run can toggle ON/OFF!

static.runSystem = buttonVars.runSystem
runSystem = static.runSystem


IDLE = 0
STEP1 = 1
STEP2 = 2
STEP3 = 3
DONE  = 4

SWITCH state
   CASE IDLE
      state = STEP1
   CASE STEP1
      state = STEP2
   CASE STEP2
      state = STEP3
   CASE STEP3
      state = DONE
   CASE DONE
      state = IDLE
ENDSWITCH

static.mvrState = state

expressions.name: MVRSim
expressions.expression:
// ===== MVR PLANT SIMULATOR =====
// Closed-loop lumped plant model. Reads the controller OUTPUTS (already exposed
// as statics), integrates with thermal LAG (simCevap) + blower/pressure
// BALLISTICS (first-order taus), and writes the sim* sensor statics that
// SensorMux feeds back to the controllers. Active only when simEnable=1, but it
// integrates harmlessly in the background otherwise.

if ( static.simEnable ) then
dt = static.timeIncSec * static.simSpeed
dt = clamp(dt, 0, 1.0)            // Euler stability guard
dtMin = dt / 60                  // minutes per tick (for ml/min flows)
static.simClock = static.simClock + dt
// slow production SURGE (two incommensurate sines + a little noise)
surge = 1 + static.simSurgeAmp * (sin(static.simClock*0.25) + 0.5*sin(static.simClock*0.83)) + 0.015*randn()
// cold-feed temperature fluctuation
static.simFeedTemp = static.simFeedSupply + static.simFeedNoise * randn()

// ---- effective actuator commands (from the controllers) ----
runOK = static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0)
blowCmd = 0
feedCmd = 0
if ( runOK ) then
    blowCmd = static.blowerRpmSet
    feedCmd = static.feedRpmSet
endif
mkDuty = static.makeupDuty
shDuty = static.superDuty
bypass = clamp(static.bypassV / 10, 0, 1)
cpump  = static.condPumpOn

// ---- blower ballistics (motor inertia) ----
static.simBlowerRpm = static.simBlowerRpm + (blowCmd - static.simBlowerRpm) * dt / static.simTauBlower
blowFrac = clamp(static.simBlowerRpm / static.simBlowerRated, 0, 1.5)
compEff  = blowFrac * (1 - bypass)

// ---- evaporator pressure -> ballistic toward saturation Psat(evapT) ----
eT = static.simEvapTemp
PsatEvap = exp((8.14019 - 1810.94 / (244.485 + eT)) * 2.302585) / 51.7149
static.simEvapPress = static.simEvapPress + (PsatEvap - static.simEvapPress) * dt / static.simTauP
static.simEvapPress = clamp(static.simEvapPress, 1, 60)

// ---- superheat from the superheat heater (lag) ----
shTarget = shDuty * static.simSHgain
static.simSuperheat = static.simSuperheat + (shTarget - static.simSuperheat) * dt / static.simTauSH
static.simVaporIn = eT + static.simSuperheat

// ---- blower: modest pressure ratio (PR ~1.1-1.2) -> small saturation lift ----
PR = 1 + (static.simPRmax - 1) * compEff
steamP = static.simEvapPress * PR
static.simSteamPress = static.simSteamPress + (steamP - static.simSteamPress) * dt / static.simTauBlower
// steam chest CONDENSES at the saturation temp of the steam-side pressure
spmm = clamp(static.simSteamPress * 51.7149, 1, 1000000000000)
sct = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(spmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
// HX (steam chest) = 24 lb steel + water with real thermal mass simChx: the
// compressed steam condenses at sct INTO the HX, the HX warms the evaporator.
// This gives a realistic warm-up lag (the slab has to come up to temp first).
QinHX = static.simUAcond * (sct - static.simSteamChest)
QoutHX = static.simUAsteam * clamp(static.simSteamChest - eT, 0, 200)
static.simSteamChest = clamp(static.simSteamChest + (QinHX - QoutHX) / static.simChx * dt, 0, 200)
// vapor OUT = inlet superheat + compression superheat (hotter than condensing temp)
compSH = static.simCompGain * (PR - 1)
voTarget = static.simVaporIn + compSH
static.simVaporOut = static.simVaporOut + (voTarget - static.simVaporOut) * dt / static.simTauBlower

// ---- evaporator energy balance (thermal LAG via simCevap) ----
feedFlow = feedCmd * 0.02
Qmakeup = mkDuty * static.simMakeupPow
Qsteam = static.simUAsteam * clamp(static.simSteamChest - eT, 0, 200)
Qfeed = feedFlow * 70 * clamp(eT - static.simFeedTemp, 0, 200)
Qloss = static.simUAloss * clamp(eT - static.simAmbient, 0, 300)
Qnet = Qmakeup + Qsteam - Qfeed - Qloss
static.simEvapTemp = clamp(eT + (Qnet / static.simCevap) * dt, 0, 160)

// ---- production (vapor) once near boiling -> condensate flow + level ----
prod = 0
if ( static.simEvapTemp > 95 ) then
    prod = clamp((Qmakeup + Qsteam - Qloss) / 40000, 0, 5) * surge
endif
static.simProd = static.simProd + (prod - static.simProd) * dt / 2

// ---- evaporator inventory (feed mass balance): feed in vs vapor boiled off ----
static.simEvapInv = clamp(static.simEvapInv + (feedFlow*1000 - static.simProd*1000) * dtMin, 0, 8000)

// ---- condensate: HX holdup (formation DELAY) -> tank -> pump, two level sensors ----
prodMl = static.simProd * 1000                       // ml/min condensing
static.simCondHold = clamp(static.simCondHold + prodMl * dtMin, 0, static.simCondHoldMax)
flowToTank = 0
if ( static.simCondHold >= static.simCondHoldMax ) then
    flowToTank = prodMl                              // holdup full -> condensate flows out
endif
pumpOut = 0
if ( cpump ) then
    pumpOut = static.simPumpMlMin
endif
static.simCondVol = clamp(static.simCondVol + (flowToTank - pumpOut) * dtMin, 0, 600)
static.simCondHigh = 0
if ( static.simCondVol >= static.condHighML ) then
    static.simCondHigh = 1
endif
static.simCondLow = 0
if ( static.simCondVol >= static.condLowML ) then
    static.simCondLow = 1
endif
// flow meter reads flowToTank, deliberately mis-calibrated + noisy (L/min)
static.simCondFlow = flowToTank / 1000 * static.simFlowCalErr * (1 + static.simFlowNoise * randn())
static.simCondLevel = static.simCondVol / static.condHighML   // 0..1 proxy for charts

// ---- condensate temp: HOT at startup (HX hot, makeup full); cools as
// production establishes and the makeup heater backs off ----
coolFrac = clamp((1 - mkDuty) + static.simProd * 1.5, 0, 1)
condTarget = static.simSteamChest - static.simCondSubcool * coolFrac
static.simCondTemp = static.simCondTemp + (condTarget - static.simCondTemp) * dt / 8

// ---- demister water (slow accumulation; DemisterDrain bleeds it) ----
drainOn = static.yDemisterWater > static.demisterThresh
static.simDemisterWater = clamp(static.simDemisterWater + (0.04 - drainOn * 0.5) * dt / 60, 0, 5)
// Flood is a SEPARATE, HIGHER fault sensor -- only rises when the drain
// can't keep up (water well above the drain level). Normal op -> ~0.
static.simDemisterFlood = clamp(static.simDemisterWater - (static.demisterThresh + 1.5), 0, 5)

static.simFeedTemp = static.simFeedSupply
endif
